instruction: Configure Chrome to automatically play all website videos at 1.5x speed by default for more efficient viewing.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not have a built-in setting to set a default video playback speed that applies globally to all videos across all websites. Video playback speed controls are specific to each video player implementation and cannot be configured globally in Chrome settings.
